name: sandbox
description: Exclusive disposable Studio places for isolated testing of a worktree

acquire.description: Reserve a free slot for this task and worktree; nothing opens yet

arguments.name: slot
arguments.description: Configured slot name; default: any free slot

prepare.description: Continue toward a clean, loaded Studio; repeat until ready is true

refresh.description: Replace the stopped sandbox contents with the worktree's current projection

run.description: Run a Renium runtime, input or capture command against the owned sandbox

arguments.name: args
arguments.description: JSON array of command tokens, e.g. ["status"]

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Runtime question being answered; required to start Play or tst

release.description: Close the owned Studio, erase its test data and return the slot; repeat until released is true

arguments.name: confirm-closed
arguments.description: You closed the test place yourself; only for a lost launch receipt

status.description: Show slot ownership and progress without touching Studio
